title: Private Gourmet Walking Tour in Carmel with Tastings
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb: This private gourmet walking tour lets you discover Carmel through authentic local flavors. Enjoy a relaxed journey with a professional local guide while every tasting is included. Begin with fresh Japanese specialties before exploring Carmel Plaza's vibrant culinary scene. Sample local honey and discover how California's flowers influence every variety. Continue with carefully selected artisan cheeses that celebrate regional craftsmanship. Finish with a guided wine tasting featuring California wines in an elegant tasting room. The short walking distances create a comfortable experience with plenty of time to enjoy every stop. This half-day food tasting tour combines local traditions with Carmel's charming atmosphere. Please note: The program and attractions may vary based on booking date/time and crowd conditions, ensuring each visit is a unique experience.
